erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.4.tekst.0: Greetings from Guhcapulco! The beach is
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.4.tekst.1: super chonky. Sand gets everywhere, even
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.4.tekst.2: in my clipboard. Structural report on the
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.5.tekst.0: Hello from the Nibble Alps! I climbed a
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.5.tekst.1: mountain (by ski lift). At the top there
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.5.tekst.2: was cheese fondue. I'm now officially a
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.5.tekst.3: cheese guh. Look after your homestead!
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.6.tekst.0: Bonjour from Paris-sur-Guh! The Eiffel Tower
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.6.tekst.1: is just a tall scaffold, if you ask
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.6.tekst.2: me. I bought a baguette that is
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.7.tekst.0: Ahoy from the cruise! Fourteen decks and
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.7.tekst.1: not a single clump to clear. I miss
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.7.tekst.2: your village a little. Nah, the buffet
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.7.tekst.3: is too yummy. But still, a little.
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.8.tekst.0: Aloha from Guhwaii! I'm wearing a
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.8.tekst.1: flowery shirt and a sombrero now. They
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.8.tekst.2: don't match, says everyone. I'll be back
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.8.tekst.3: soon, with sunscreen. Proud of you!
erfenis.afwerking.ansicht.bezorgd: A postcard from Realtor Guhrrit! It's also pinned to your Postcard Board.
erfenis.afwerking.boek.dagboek.0:
Monday. Made cheese. Ate cheese. Made new cheese.

Hoo-hoo says I eat too much cheese. Hoo-hoo is an owl, what does an owl know about cheese.
erfenis.afwerking.boek.dagboek.1:
Wednesday. A guh in a necktie came by. He wants a parking lot on my flowers.

I gave him a cookie and sent him packing. Nyeg.
erfenis.afwerking.boek.dagboek.2:
Sunday. Wrote my will. The homestead goes to whoever takes good care of it.

I'm hiding the last page under my oldest little tree. Shhh.
erfenis.afwerking.boek.testament.0:
My will.

My homestead goes to whoever takes good care of it, for the price of one nibble.

Not to anyone in a necktie.
erfenis.afwerking.boek.testament.1:
Look after the chickens, the cows and the cookies. Say good night to Hoo-hoo every evening.

And let Bertha sing. Even if she's off-key.
erfenis.afwerking.boek.testament.2:
A homestead is only worth something when someone loves it.

Signed,

Grandpa Nibble
(paw print)
erfenis.afwerking.cmd.geen_kelder: You don't have Grandpa's cellar yet. Solve case 5 first (or: /guhs erfenis beloning opas_kelder).
erfenis.afwerking.feestje: Village party at the Bandstand! Bertha the Cow is on stage singing (a little off-key, but with her whole heart).
erfenis.afwerking.kelder.post: Stuff from Grandpa's old cellar, kept safe for you! (It didn't fit in the new cellar, or that one only arrives on your next visit.)
erfenis.afwerking.kelder.verhuisd: Grandpa's cellar moved along, with all your stuff inside. Grandpa would be proud, nyeg!
erfenis.afwerking.oma.decobon: Granny Knitguh slips you a Deco Voucher. "Buy something pretty with it, sweetie. Nothing with neckties."
erfenis.afwerking.oma.extra: Granny Knitguh pinches your cheek and slips you a little extra: %s Guhlders. "For nibbles, sweetie!"
erfenis.afwerking.worteltje.tekst.0: With a pink bow around it, just like the border posts.
erfenis.afwerking.worteltje.tekst.1: "Sorry about the posts. Morris told me to!" - Pete
erfenis.cmd.demo: Demo village placed: Homestead 6, everything cleared, twenty-ish buildings and full baskets. Nyeg!
erfenis.cmd.geen_dim: The Inheritance dimension doesn't exist on this server.
erfenis.cmd.nog_geen_erfenis: You don't have an inheritance yet, nyeg. Just enjoy the Guhmension: the Postguh will show up with a letter from the realtor!
erfenis.cmd.reset: Your inheritance is back to how the realtor left it. Rickety.
erfenis.cmd.snel_uit: Inheritance: building takes time again (fast off).
erfenis.cmd.tijd: %s minutes passed in your village (production, builders and residents catch up).
erfenis.deco.schommelbank: Porch Swing under a Little Roof

erfenis.decowinkel.fout.bon_pad: A Deco Voucher is for a real piece of deco, not a path tile.
erfenis.decowinkel.fout.geen_bon: You have no Deco Vouchers left. They're in the FTB chapter "A Fixer-Upper!".
erfenis.decowinkel.fout.geld_op: All gone: the Guhlders ran out after %s tiles.
erfenis.decowinkel.fout.hier_niet: Can't do that here (overgrown, or a building or deco in the way).
erfenis.decowinkel.fout.niet_te_koop: That's a special piece: you can't buy it, you earn it!
erfenis.decowinkel.fout.op_pad: A fence right in the middle of the path? Everyone would trip, nyeg.
erfenis.decowinkel.gum_tip: Drag over paths and fences to remove them. They go into your stock and you can draw them again later for free.

erfenis.decowinkel.klik_bon: Click: place with a Deco Voucher. Shift-click: with the voucher into your deco shed.
erfenis.decowinkel.klik_koop: Click: place right away (you pay when placing). Shift-click: buy for your deco shed.
erfenis.decowinkel.klik_trek: Click, then drag over the grass to draw. Corners and crossings sort themselves out, wahoog.
erfenis.decowinkel.ok.gekocht: %s is in your deco shed. Cozy!
erfenis.decowinkel.ok.getrokken_voorraad: %s tiles of %s added! (Ƒ%s, %s free from your stock)
erfenis.decowinkel.sleep_tip: Tip: drag the piece to move it.
erfenis.decowinkel.tab_tip: The deco shop: paths, fences and cozy knickknacks for Guhlders. The higher your Homestead, the more choice, nyeg!
erfenis.decowinkel.verplaats_tip: Pick it up and put it somewhere else. R rotates. You can also just drag it.
erfenis.decowinkel.voorraad: %s in your deco shed (place for free)
erfenis.decowinkel.voorraad_tegels: %s tiles in your stock (used first, for free)
erfenis.decowinkel.weg_tip: Back in your deco shed. Free, and you lose nothing.
erfenis.doel.vadskracht: Chonk power at the Chonk Mast: %s/%s
erfenis.fout.bouwer: All builders are busy. Wait a bit, or build a Carpentry Barn.
erfenis.fout.buiten: That doesn't fit on your inheritance.
erfenis.fout.deco_op: That piece isn't in your deco shed anymore.
erfenis.fout.eerst_opruimen: Clear all 72 clumps first, then you can buy plots.
erfenis.fout.geen_plot: You're not standing on an inheritance.
erfenis.fout.hoeve_level: Can't go higher than your Homestead: reach Homestead level %s first.
erfenis.fout.item_ontbreekt: %s can't go home yet (that block doesn't exist in this version yet).
erfenis.fout.leverkist_cap: The Delivery Chest takes only %s more of this right now (max %s per hour, saves up for 8 hours).
erfenis.fout.limiet: You already have the maximum of %s.
erfenis.fout.loges_max: 2 guests are already helping there. No room for more in the kitchen.
erfenis.fout.loket: Some stuff from the main world is still missing: hand it in at the counter.
erfenis.fout.loket_geen: You don't have any %s on you.
erfenis.fout.loket_nodig: You need a Building Supplies Counter for this first.
erfenis.fout.max: Already at the highest level. Wahoog!
erfenis.fout.niet_eigen: This isn't your inheritance. Look, don't touch!
erfenis.fout.niet_naar_huis: %s stays in the village (a half-product: at home you make it yourself).
erfenis.fout.overwoekerd: It's still overgrown there. Clear it first!
erfenis.fout.palet: You get that palette at Homestead level %s.
erfenis.fout.pension_bezig: That guh is busy. Bring them back first (little house, Guh Wheel...).
erfenis.fout.pension_dubbel: That guh is already walking around somewhere. Huh?!
erfenis.fout.pension_niet: That guh can't come stay over right now.
erfenis.fout.pension_roep: That guh is too far away. Call them over first (Guhdex: Call to me).
erfenis.fout.pension_vol: The Guh Guesthouse is full (%s guests). Upgrade it for more beds.
erfenis.fout.recept_geheim: You don't know that recipe yet. Maybe a sniffer knows more about it...
erfenis.fout.vol: Your storage is full! Build or upgrade a Storage Barn.
erfenis.gebouw.akker.uitleg: Pick a crop, the residents do the rest: wheat, pink grain, carrots, flowers or fluffballs.
erfenis.gebouw.bakkerij.uitleg: Bread, cookies, carrot cake and pink nibble cookies. It smells super wahoog in here.
erfenis.gebouw.bijenhof.uitleg: Hives among the flowers: honey and wax. The bees buzz softly and chonkily.
erfenis.gebouw.boomgaard.uitleg: Fruit trees and nibbleberry bushes. Picking is allowed, and a little snacking too.
erfenis.gebouw.bosje.uitleg: Woodcutter guhs chop logs (and always plant a new sapling in return).
erfenis.gebouw.bouwblokkenwerkplaats.uit: Makes Site Shed blocks of your choice from planks. Pick more than one and you get a cheerful mix.
erfenis.gebouw.detectivebureau.uitleg: Sherlock Guh and Doctor Chonkson. Cases come in at set times. Elementary, my dear nyeg.
erfenis.gebouw.dorpscafe.uitleg: Cooper pours cheese milk and knows all the gossip. All production +5%%, +10%% (level 5), +15%% (level 9).
erfenis.gebouw.eendenvijver.uitleg: Guh ducklings give down and duck eggs. Quack means nyeg in Duck.
erfenis.gebouw.glasblazerij.uitleg: Sand becomes glass for the village, or glass shards to make your own glass at home.
erfenis.gebouw.groeve.uitleg: Stone from the cliff face, and now and then a lump of clay.
erfenis.gebouw.guhhutje.uitleg: A home for new village guhs: hut, farmhouse, row house, villa. Someone moves in every 15 minutes.
erfenis.gebouw.guhpension.uitleg: Your own tamed guhs stay over here. They wander your inheritance and help a building: +5%% each.
erfenis.gebouw.hoeve.uitleg: The heart of your fixer-upper. From rickety shed (structural report: chonky) to a great snuggle homestead with a little tower. Keeps your Guhlders and decides how far everything can go.
erfenis.gebouw.houtzagerij.uitleg: Saws logs into planks or beams. For the village itself: only raw logs go home.
erfenis.gebouw.kaarsenmakerij.uitleg: Wax becomes candles in your favorite color, or lanterns. Needs chonk power, or the candles stay out.
erfenis.gebouw.kaasmakerij.uitleg: Milk becomes cheese. From level 3 also cheese nibbles (only for home, nyeg!).
erfenis.gebouw.kippenhok.uitleg: Nibble chicks lay eggs (and lose feathers). The first Chicken Coop is free: a gift from the realtor.
erfenis.gebouw.koeienstal.uitleg: Guh cows in the meadow give milk. Moo, but the sweet kind.
erfenis.gebouw.loket.uitleg: Hand in stuff from the main world here for the big renovations (Homestead 7 and up).
erfenis.gebouw.mammoetwei.uitleg: Mammoth guhs with giant wool in big bulk. They need chonk power, or they doze off (snore).
erfenis.gebouw.marktplein.uitleg: Cart stalls for the orders from the neighboring villages. The higher, the more carts at once.
erfenis.gebouw.molen.uitleg: Grinds wheat into flour (and pink grain into pink flour). The sails have guh ears.
erfenis.gebouw.muziektent.uitleg: A village party now and then. All production +5%%, +10%% (level 5), +15%% (level 9).
erfenis.gebouw.opslagschuur.uitleg: All your goods go in here: eggs, wool, planks, cheese... The higher, the more fits. Don't stack them on the guhs, nyeg.
erfenis.gebouw.schaapskooi.uitleg: Guh lambs give white wool. From Homestead 7 and level 7, cloud lambs join in: extra fluff!
erfenis.gebouw.speeltuin.uitleg: Baby guhs on the swings attract new residents: extra room and moving in twice as fast.
erfenis.gebouw.steenbakkerij.uitleg: Bakes bricks from clay or stone, and smooth stone. The chimney puffs pink smoke.
erfenis.gebouw.timmerschuur.uitleg: Home of extra builders in little yellow hard hats. Level 1: a 2nd builder. Level 7: a 3rd builder. Wahoog!
erfenis.gebouw.vadsmast.uitleg: Catches the chonk power your Village Transmitter sends out from home. For the top workshops and the little mammoths.
erfenis.gebouw.zandkuil.uitleg: Raked sand under a little parasol. Sand Guh says: no use crying over spilled sand.
erfenis.kaart.bestel.cadeau: %s thanks you with: %s! (in your deco shed)
erfenis.kaart.bestel.geleverd: Delivered to %s! +%s ƒ. They wave you goodbye.
erfenis.kaart.bestel.geleverd_ster: STAR ORDER delivered to %s! +%s ƒ. Wahoog!
erfenis.kaart.bestel.geweigerd: The cart rolls back empty. It'll come back later with something else.
erfenis.kaart.bestel.hulp_van: %s lent you a hand: this order pays 20%% more!
erfenis.kaart.bestel.leeg: No neighboring villages with orders yet. Hang on, they're on their way!
erfenis.kaart.bestel.leveren.tekort: You don't have everything in storage yet. No rush: an order never expires.
erfenis.kaart.bestel.leveren.uitleg: Send the goods along with the cart and get your Guhlders.
erfenis.kaart.bestel.reden.12: because the little mouse ate everything
erfenis.kaart.bestel.reden.13: for the prettiest veggie patch contest
erfenis.kaart.bestel.reden.16: because they want to bake the biggest cake ever
erfenis.kaart.bestel.reden.17: for Granny Guh, who says she only wants "a tiny little bit"
erfenis.kaart.bestel.reden.19: because their own chickens are on strike (they want more cuddles)
erfenis.kaart.bestel.reden.5: for a very important afternoon nap
erfenis.kaart.bestel.reden.7: for the summer party on the village square
erfenis.kaart.bestel.reden.9: because the neighbors have it too
erfenis.kaart.bestel.rust: The cart is taking a little rest.
erfenis.kaart.bestel.ster_reden.1: the wedding of two very lovestruck guhs
erfenis.kaart.bestel.ster_reden.3: the crowning of the Chonkiest Guh of the Year
erfenis.kaart.bestel.ster_reden.6: the opening of their new snuggle bridge
erfenis.kaart.bestel.ster_reden.7: the whole village's birthday, all at once
erfenis.kaart.bestel.sub: Market Square level %s: %s carts. %s orders delivered so far.
erfenis.kaart.bestel.sub_geen: No Market Square yet: %s carts. %s orders delivered so far.
erfenis.kaart.bestel.tekort: You're still %s %s short. No rush, nyeg!
erfenis.kaart.bestel.terug_leeg: The cart rolls back empty to %s. Something else soon!
erfenis.kaart.bestel.terug_vol: The cart rolls happily back to %s, full of your goods.
erfenis.kaart.bestel.weigeren.uitleg: The cart rolls back empty and returns later with something else. Nobody's upset.
erfenis.kaart.bestellingen.geen_buur: This village isn't your neighbor: it orders from someone else.
erfenis.kaart.bestellingen.uitleg: View and deliver your neighboring villages' orders.
erfenis.kaart.bezoeken.uitleg: Go there as a visitor. Look, don't touch, chonk!
